He has relied on Aparna Joseph@Current KunjuKunju and Others Vs. State of Kerala AIR 1973 1, Vijayan Vs. State of Kerala 2009 (3) SCC (Cri.) 585, Dr. Subhash Kashinath Mahajan Vs. opennyai_summary.final__ANALYSIS:
Appellant was already married with living spouse and continued the relationship with the victim abusing his position.
In the Indian Penal Code, 1860 "Sex by abuse of authority" has been recognized in dual ways.
One under the sub-clause of Section 376 (2) if proved as non consensual and under section 376 C if proved as consensual.
If proved to be consensual sexual intercourse obtained by a public servant it would fall under Section 376 C of the IPC.
Accordingly, provisions of section 3(2)(v)
of the Scheduled Caste & Scheduled Tribe (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 are attracted in this case and it cannot be concluded that accusations relating the commission of above offence are devoid of merits.

(Supra) and Manju Devi (Supra).
